main_text.l: ΘΕΟΔΩΡΗΤΟΥ Ἐπισκόπου κύρου λόγοι ιζ. πρὸς Ἀρφόρυς θέσεις.

page.notes: The Greek text is set in a Greek typeface and is only approximately reproduced; the Greek in the left column (title and first lines) is hard to read on the scan and may contain errors. The ornamental band at top and the page number were printed. Catchword: "Pri-" is the hyphenated start of the next page, shown at the foot of the right column.
